decisions.reason: Its visibility increased from a mention to a dedicated page by 2024, so relative to the firm's aspiration for an adjacent module it appears to be meeting expectations and is worth retaining in the modular platform.
This product kept a dedicated page across both years and fits the firm's industrial measurement and control core, indicating performance at or above aspiration and strong strategic fit.

Although it was only mentioned rather than strongly promoted, it remained on the website into 2024 and is close to the established offer, so with organisational slack the firm would likely keep it as a complementary platform module while demand is still assessed.

As a 2024 launch that extends the existing modular system, it is too early to judge harshly against aspiration and the firm's growth and broad product logic support keeping it for another learning period.

The remote access service supports the firm's stated expansion in wallbox, load-management and energy-management offerings, so even with limited early evidence it is strategically important enough to keep while the market develops.
